translation: In summer, when heat enters the blood after a long time, the condition of blood accumulation is most common, with delirious speech and clouded mania. The way to judge is that the urine is clear and copious and the stool is necessarily black. Taohe Chengqi Tang is the essential medicine.

Using much Wumei in malaria is the intent of draining wood with sourness and settling earth. Using Changshan and Caoguo is to rob the cold of the Great Yin; because Changshan moves extremely swiftly, it keeps the two pathogens from combining. Using Renshen and Shengjiang is called Lu Jiang Yin, one to secure the origin and one to disperse the pathogen, taking the meaning of freeing the spirit and removing foulness.
In sum, in prolonged malaria the qi is weakened, so anything that strengthens the gallbladder qi can stop the malaria; there is not necessarily a real malaria ghost.
